description: Last-resort fallback for a real user mistake (cp_loss >= 50) with a clear better_move but NO shape / NO principle / NO firing R-rule. Severity tier respects [[cp-loss-is-not-material]] — never translate cp_loss to 'X pawns lost'. When the V5 board_state_describer composed a board_state_clause (Mohit 2026-05-21), prefer the with_board_state variant so the caption is coach-voice geometry instead of bare engine-speak ('X was better').

fact_glossary.severity_phrase: Authored phrase picked from severity_phrases via severity_tiers
fact_glossary.board_state_clause: Pre-rendered string from board_state_describer (1-3 facts joined). When present, basic_mistake renders the with_board_state variant so the user gets concrete board geometry instead of just 'X was better.'
